roster.name: DDI Common Core (ISO/PAS 25955:2026)
roster.description: A core metadata model (now formalized as ISO/PAS 25955:2026) defining a minimal, exchangeable set of metadata elements for describing studies and datasets across the DDI family — aimed at discovery and basic interoperability.

roster.name: DDI-Codebook (DDI-C)
roster.description: A DDI product/specification for coding and describing single datasets or data files: variables, value labels, code lists, file-level metadata and documentation commonly used for archival and dataset-level metadata exchange.

roster.name: DDI-Lifecycle (DDI-L)
roster.description: A richer DDI model covering the full research data lifecycle (study design, instruments, events, collection, processing, weighting, analysis and preservation) for longitudinal and multi-stage study metadata.

roster.name: DDI-Cross-Domain Integration (DDI-CDI)
roster.description: A DDI specification intended to support integration and harmonization across datasets and domains — models for linking unit-record data, harmonized variables, cross-study comparability and cross-domain metadata.

roster.name: Extended Knowledge Organization System (XKOS)
roster.description: An extension of SKOS for modelling statistical classifications, code lists and hierarchies (e.g., industry, occupation, geographic classifications) to represent classification schemes used in statistical and survey metadata.

roster.name: Structured Data Transformation Language (SDTL)
roster.description: A specification/language for describing structured data transformations and mappings (ETL-style) to document and reproduce conversion workflows between data formats and metadata schemas.
